fullPassage: When you are successful and the new habit feels normal, it is time to create an anchor. The anchor is valuable for those situations in which you threaten to loose your new habit. I once created the habit of seeing beauty in every human being. So when I felt the habit was mine, I bought myself a geode, a stone that can be found around volcanoes. Geodes are rough on the outside but if you break them in two, inside there is a lovely cave filled with shining crystals. So I put the geode on my desk and after a year or so I had had a row with a person and I was really angry. I came into my office and threw my bag on the ground. "What a bad person!" I said out loud, and immediately my eye was drawn like a magnet to the geode and I realised that here I had a person with a very rough outside, but somewhere inside there must be something beautiful.

det.korean: ① 습관을 살린 돌: 앵커의 힘 — 정답, ② 화산 근처의 지오드 — 오답, ③ 일상 분노 관리 — 오답, ④ 수정의 지질학 — 오답
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'A Stone That Saved a Habit: The Power of an Anchor' — 지오드(돌)가 앵커로서 습관을 유지하는 데 도움이 됐다는 글의 핵심과 정확히 일치 ← 정답
❌ ② 지오드가 화산 근처에서 발견된다는 세부 사실만 부각, 글의 핵심 아님
❌ ③ 분노 관리 기법이 아닌, 앵커를 통한 습관 유지가 주제
❌ ④ 수정의 지질학은 글의 소재일 뿐, 주제 아님
det.tip: 제목은 글의 핵심 메시지를 포괄해야 함. 앵커(geode)와 습관 유지라는 두 키워드가 모두 담겨야 함

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: When you are successful and the new habit feels normal, it is time to create an anchor. The anchor is valuable for those situations in which you threaten to loose your new habit. I once created the habit of seeing beauty in every human being. So when I felt the habit was mine, I bought myself a geode, a stone that can be found around volcanoes. Geodes are rough on the outside but if you break them in two, inside there is a lovely cave filled with shining crystals. So I put the geode on my desk and after a year or so I had had a row with a person and I was really angry. I came into my office and threw my bag on the ground. "What a bad person!" I said out loud, and immediately my eye was drawn <u>like a magnet</u> to the geode and I realised that here I had a person with a very rough outside, but somewhere inside there must be something beautiful.
ch: 앵커인 지오드가 강렬하고 저항할 수 없는 방식으로 시선을 끌어당겼다.

det.korean: ① 금속 자기력 실제 작용 — 오답(비유 해석 오류), ② 자석 원리와 지오드 관련 — 오답, ③ 분노가 지오드를 끌어당김 — 오답, ④ 강렬하고 저항할 수 없이 시선을 끌었다 — 정답
det.analysis:
❌ ① 실제 자기력이 작용한 것이 아니라 비유적 표현
❌ ② 자석의 과학 원리와 지오드 형성을 연결한 잘못된 해석
❌ ③ 분노가 지오드를 끌어당긴 것이 아니라, 글쓴이의 시선이 끌린 것
✅ ④ 'drawn like a magnet to the geode' — 자석처럼 저항할 수 없는 강한 끌림으로 시선이 지오드에 고정됐다는 함축 ← 정답
det.tip: 'drawn like a magnet' = 자석에 끌리듯 강하고 본능적으로 시선이 끌렸다는 비유적 표현

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 <u>them</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: When you are successful and the new habit feels normal, it is time to create an anchor. The anchor is valuable for those situations in which you threaten to loose your new habit. I once created the habit of seeing beauty in every human being. So when I felt the habit was mine, I bought myself a geode, a stone that can be found around volcanoes. Geodes are rough on the outside but if you break <u>them</u> in two, inside there is a lovely cave filled with shining crystals. So I put the geode on my desk and after a year or so I had had a row with a person and I was really angry. I came into my office and threw my bag on the ground. "What a bad person!" I said out loud, and immediately my eye was drawn like a magnet to the geode and I realised that here I had a person with a very rough outside, but somewhere inside there must be something beautiful.

det.korean: ① 수정들 — 오답(아직 등장 전), ② 지오드들 — 정답(바로 앞 문장의 Geodes를 받음), ③ 화산들 — 오답, ④ 상황들 — 오답
det.analysis:
❌ ① 수정(crystals)은 them 이후에 등장하는 내용으로, 선행사가 될 수 없음
✅ ② 'Geodes are rough on the outside but if you break them in two' — them은 바로 앞 문장의 주어 Geodes를 지칭 ← 정답
❌ ③ volcanoes는 이미 앞 문장에 나왔으나 문맥상 them과 무관
❌ ④ situations는 글 앞부분에 나온 단어로 문맥상 연결되지 않음
det.tip: 대명사 them은 복수 명사를 지칭. 바로 앞 문장의 Geodes가 복수이고 주어이므로 them = Geodes

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 <u>it</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: When you are successful and the new habit feels normal, it is time to create an anchor. The anchor is valuable for those situations in which you threaten to loose your new habit. I once created the habit of seeing beauty in every human being. So when I felt <u>it</u> was mine, I bought myself a geode, a stone that can be found around volcanoes. Geodes are rough on the outside but if you break them in two, inside there is a lovely cave filled with shining crystals. So I put the geode on my desk and after a year or so I had had a row with a person and I was really angry. I came into my office and threw my bag on the ground. "What a bad person!" I said out loud, and immediately my eye was drawn like a magnet to the geode and I realised that here I had a person with a very rough outside, but somewhere inside there must be something beautiful.

det.korean: it은 바로 앞 문장의 'the habit(of seeing beauty in every human being)'을 지칭. ① 시기 — 오답, ② 지오드 구입 — 오답, ③ 아름다움 보는 습관 — 정답, ④ 가방 던짐 — 오답
det.analysis:
❌ ① '새로운 습관을 만드는 시기'는 첫 문장의 'time to create'와 관련되나, it의 지칭어가 아님
❌ ② 지오드 구입은 it의 결과이지 지칭 대상 아님
✅ ③ 'I once created the habit of seeing beauty in every human being. So when I felt it was mine' — it은 바로 앞 문장의 'the habit(of seeing beauty in every human being)'을 지칭 ← 정답
❌ ④ 가방을 던진 것은 뒷부분 내용으로 문맥상 연결되지 않음
det.tip: 'I once created the habit of seeing beauty...' 바로 다음 문장의 it = the habit. 대명사는 가장 가까운 앞 명사를 지칭
